title: Infer an Alien Dictionary Order
prompt:
Implement `alien_order(words) -> str`. `words` is a non-empty list of non-empty lowercase strings already sorted according to an unknown alphabet. Return any string containing every distinct character exactly once in an order consistent with the input. Return `""` when no such order exists because of a precedence cycle or because a longer word appears immediately before its own prefix, such as `["abc", "ab"]`. Characters that never participate in a precedence edge must still appear. Ignore duplicate edges. Target `O(C + V + E)` time, where `C` is the total input size.

Evidence boundary: a recent Uber L5A MLE report confirms only a topological-sort question family. A separate Uber MLE-2 report identifies Alien Dictionary as the concrete variant, so this exercise does not claim the recent report used this exact prompt.

example.reasoning: Adjacent first differences imply w before e, e before r, r before t, and t before f.
